title: DLPMI: Differentiable Lumped-Parameter Model Inversion for Environmental Tracer Data
description: Lumped-parameter model inversion for environmental tracer data using automatic differentiation, with identifiability, tracer information-content, model-structure and scale-marginalised Bayesian diagnostics. Version 2.0.0 corrects three defects in 1.0.0 that changed numerical output; see CHANGELOG.md.
